text: Professor, I wanted to ask you about the offer to be a teaching assistant for your class next semester. Yes, are you interested? I am, but I wanted to know more about what my responsibilities would be. As a teaching assistant, you would be responsible for grading student assignments and leading sessions to discuss readings. Okay, that sounds doable. What else would I need to do? You would also need to attend all of the lectures and be available to answer student questions outside of class. That makes sense. Would I need to prepare anything for the discussion sessions I lead? No, I would provide you with all of the materials you need. I would just expect you to lead the discussions and help students understand the material better. Okay, that sounds like something I can do. When do you need an answer? The sooner the better so that I can start making arrangements for next semester. Do you have any other questions? No, that’s everything for now. Thank you!
